title: BOOKSMITH per-book config
description: The single per-book config object that parameterizes the entire BOOKSMITH toolchain. It externalizes every knob currently hard-coded across the clone scripts (title/trim/paper/margins/spine/formats/cover/metadata/authorship/voice). Downstream builders read ONLY this object plus the version-pinned manuscript. Defaults encode the proven values from the research corpus (6x9, Georgia, mirror-margin injection, KDP hardcover +0.348 board-add, Mixam 0.80 bleed, etc.).

title.description: Book title as printed on the cover + front matter.

subtitle.description: Optional subtitle. Keep 'Book 1' OUT of the subtitle (Amazon compilation-detector signal).

slug.description: Filesystem-safe identifier. Drives book_workspace/<slug>/ and all output filenames.

genre.description: Free-text genre/register label (e.g. 'literary fiction', 'AI-career nonfiction'). (orchestrator/agent-consumed; not read by the build toolchain).

is_fiction.description: Selects the fiction copyright disclaimer + fiction_refs handling; false enables the LaTeX->Unicode math path.

language.description: BCP-47 language tag for EPUB dc:language + xml:lang (read by build_epub.py). Defaults to 'en'.

math.description: Explicit math-book flag for the residual-LaTeX gate (verify_build.py). Defaults to (is_fiction == false) when absent; set true to force the check for a fiction book with equations, or false to silence it for a $-bearing nonfiction book.

domain.description: Production domain. Default 'book' = the full nine-format book pipeline (this schema). A non-book domain (e.g. 'course') is declared in domains/<name>/domain.json and drives the deterministic engine's stages + producers + verifier; such a config is validated by its domain, not this schema. A book config may omit this or set 'book'.

integration_mode.description: How multiple intake sources become ONE book. synthesis (default): re-derive from first principles — the core stays the core, satellites DISSOLVE in; recombination is not synthesis. anthology: parts intentionally stay distinct. reforge: an existing manuscript reborn, re-synthesized strictly better in the author's register. Asked once at intake when a core + satellites exist; never silently assumed. (orchestrator/agent-consumed; not read by the build toolchain).

min_pages.description: HARD house floor: verify_build fails a print format whose interior page count is below this (default 75). A thinner book gives an illegible spine (spine font scales with page count) and reads as a pamphlet. Set lower ONLY as a deliberate, recorded exception; 0 disables the check. Prevention is upstream: target ~28-34K words for 6x9 to clear it with margin. See LESSONS_LEDGER §16.5.

kindle_include_toc.description: Kindle/reflowable ebooks: whether to inject a manual CONTENTS page + TableOfContents field. Default FALSE — Amazon builds navigation from the Heading-1 structure, so a manual TOC is redundant and some upload paths render it broken/blank. Kindle NEVER carries page numbers regardless. See LESSONS_LEDGER §16.4.

units.description: Canonical ORDERED unit list — the single source of unit order for assemble_manuscript.py, init_contracts.py, check_part_pages.py, and the generators. Preferred over authorship.per_chapter_overrides key order.

title.description: Display heading, e.g. 'Part I - The Dissolution'.

class.description: Optional per-unit authorship class override (else authorship.default_class).

target_words.description: Optional per-unit word target; the deterministic engine (engine.py) drafts to ~this length and gates within 0.6-1.6x. Defaults to 1500 if omitted.

dedication.description: Optional dedication text, rendered on its own centered recto page.

epigraph.description: Optional epigraph (quote + attribution) on its own centered page.

readers_note.description: Optional reader's note / preface front-matter text.

about_the_author.description: Optional extended About-the-Author back matter (Kindle + print); falls back to a factual one-liner if absent.

trim.description: Physical trim size in inches. 6x9 is the house default across every shipped book.

paper.description: cream = literary/premium (spine per_page 0.0025); white = tech register (0.002252). Note: KDP hardcover only offers white.

blurb_paper.description: Blurb trade paper (drives the blurb spine/cover lookup in print_presets.json). standard_trade_bw = the B&W text-book default; standard_trade = color paper.

finish.description: Cover finish. Matte is the literary house default. (orchestrator/agent-consumed; not read by the build toolchain).

formats.description: Which upload-ready formats to produce. Literary/premium ships all 5; tech register drops mixam_hardcover. (orchestrator/agent-consumed; not read by the build toolchain).

interior.description: Interior typography + margin geometry. Values in inches unless noted. Defaults are the proven KDP-tight set; the Mixam profile overrides margins to the looser binding-comfort set at build time.

body_font.description: Body font. Georgia chosen for universal system availability; not embedded.

body_pt.description: Body point size (12 for novellas/premium; 11 for denser nonfiction).

leading.description: Line spacing in DXA/twips, 'atLeast' rule (340 ~= 1.4x at 12pt; 320 ~= 1.35x at 11pt).

gutter_in.description: Spine-side (inside) margin. 0.75in absorbs justified trailing-space + italic side-bearing overshoot KDP flags; exceeds KDP's 0.625in min. Mixam profile uses 0.875in.

ornament_glyph.description: Section-break / part ornament (U+2726 four-pointed star), rendered in the ornament_font.

ornament_font.description: Font used to render ornament_glyph in the generators. Segoe UI Symbol ships with Windows and carries the U+2726 star; change only if your box lacks it.

code_font.description: Monospace font for inline `backtick` code runs in the generators. Consolas is the Windows default.

math_font.description: Font tagged on LaTeX->Unicode math runs in the generators. Cambria Math is the Windows default; latex_to_unicode.js emits glyphs this font renders well.

include_toc.description: PRINT interiors: build a CONTENTS/TOC page. Default true. TOC entries MUST be title-case at normal tracking with a right-tab dot leader — NEVER wide-tracked ALL-CAPS (they wrap and collide with the leaders, garbling the Contents page). See LESSONS_LEDGER §16.3.

page_number_align.description: Footer page-number placement. House style = center (bottom-center on every page). 'outer' = recto-right / verso-left (the old default). See LESSONS_LEDGER §16.2.

chapter_art.description: OPTIONAL chapter-opener illustrations, convention over configuration: when the dir exists and holds <unit_id>.png files, the generators (print DOCX, Kindle DOCX, EPUB) inject each image directly after its unit heading. Absent dir or file = silent no-op; manuscript markdown is never marked up. Ids bind to unit headings by position (the EPUB count gate protects the binding).

enabled.description: Master switch. Even when true, art is injected only for units whose <unit_id>.png exists.

dir.description: Workspace-relative folder holding one <unit_id>.png per illustrated unit.

width_in.description: Rendered width in inches in the print interior (height follows the image aspect). Kindle/EPUB reflow responsively.

front_matter.description: Ordered ceremonial front-matter sequence. Each entry becomes its own one-page section (required for vAlign injection). Recto elements land on odd pages; blank versos are auto-inserted.

recto_strategy.description: odd_page_sections = per-chapter SectionType.ODD_PAGE + trailing EVEN_PAGE blank (robust, preferred). blank_verso_cascade = legacy brittle single-blank-before-part-II trick (avoid).

cover.description: Cover typography + palette + AI-art generation params. Rule: NO title/author text baked into the AI art; typography composited afterward.

mood.description: Optional no-GPU cover mood override (cover_pick/hypergen): dark_literary, warm_memoir, cool_scifi, bold_thriller, soft_romance, earthy_nonfiction, noir, botanical. Inferred from genre when absent.

title_face.description: Cover display face. Currently INFORMATIONAL ONLY: composite_cover.py always renders the vendored Cormorant Garamond (variable Light 300-700 + Bold TTF); a family override here has no effect on the composited typography yet. See fonts/library/FONTS.md for candidate faces should the override be wired.

palette.description: Hex colors (no #) driving composite typography + overlays.

author_tracking_em.description: Wide small-caps author tracking in em.

art.description: AI cover-art generation config (cover_gen.py -> ComfyUI via hermes skill).

checkpoint.description: ComfyUI checkpoint filename in models/checkpoints/. Default SDXL base (~6.5GB, fits 16GB VRAM). Flux-dev-fp8 (~12GB) opt-in for best composition.

workflow.description: ComfyUI API-format workflow graph under the hermes comfyui skill's workflows/ (sdxl_txt2img.json | flux_dev_txt2img.json).

prompt_seed.description: The Book-Bible-derived art prompt seed (genre, mood, palette, motifs, period-accuracy rules). NEVER include title/author text.

negative_prompt.default: text, watermark, letters, title, signature, frame, border

seed.description: -1 = randomize. run_batch.py sweeps seeds for variants.

reroll_budget.description: Max re-rolls before the cover loop hard-stops to the human. (orchestrator/agent-consumed; not read by the build toolchain).

isbn_keepout.description: Bottom-right ISBN barcode keep-out on the back panel. KDP auto-overlays its barcode here; reserve nothing, just keep it clear (do NOT bake a box).

center_icon.description: Optional emblem centered on EVERY front cover (print wraps + kindle), between the title block and the subtitle block. Alpha-masked; native colors kept unless `ink` is set (then the alpha becomes a solid-ink stencil); a soft cream under-glow lifts it off textured art unless glow:false. Trademark note: shipping another party's mark on a cover is an IP-counsel item on the upload checklist.

path.description: Workspace-relative image path (PNG with alpha preferred).

center_y_frac.description: Vertical center as a fraction of front-panel height (clamped below the title block).

ink.description: Optional hex ink (no #): render the icon's alpha as this solid color instead of its native colors.

ebook_logo.description: Optional emblem composited onto EBOOK front covers only (the kindle + digital profiles; print wraps untouched). The source's dark pixels become tinted ink on the cover field (alpha = darkness), so B&W line art reads as cover-native ink rather than a pasted white plate. Trademark note: shipping another party's mark on a cover is an IP-counsel item on the upload checklist.

path.description: Workspace-relative source image (PNG/JPG; dark-on-light line art works best).

center_y_frac.description: Vertical center of the emblem as a fraction of trim height.

ink.description: Hex ink color, no #. Defaults to the compositor's body ink.

spine.description: Spine-width math constants. spine_in = pages * per_page_paper + board_add. pages is a SINGLE re-derived variable read from the generated PDF (never hard-coded in three places). Always calibrate against the KDP Print Previewer / Mixam job calculator.

kdp_hardcover_board_add.description: KDP hardcover case-board+endpaper add (2026 spec, empirically verified against a Previewer rejection; legacy 0.302 caused v1 rejections). Some white-paper books calibrated to 0.241-0.246.

mixam_board_add.description: Mixam board add is NON-constant (0.160@204pp -> 0.110@548pp). Reverse-derive from Mixam's job calculator; this is a starting estimate only.

kdp_hardcover_turn_in_in.description: KDP hardcover case-wrap turn-in on all 4 sides (NOT bleed). Uploading a 0.125in-bleed paperback wrap to a hardcover listing is rejected.

kdp_hardcover_height_in.description: Hardcover wrap height hardcoded to 10.417 (arithmetic gives 10.416; KDP's 4-decimal validator expects 10.417).

kdp_bleed_in.description: KDP paperback single-wrap bleed all sides.

mixam_bleed_in.description: Mixam cover bleed all sides (unusually thick - paper wraps case boards).

calibrate_against_previewer.description: On dimension rejection, reverse-derive the board-add from the Previewer's stated expected wrap width rather than trusting a formula.

spine_override_in.description: Escape hatch: a Previewer/Mixam-stated EXACT spine width (inches) that bypasses the formula entirely. Set after a dimension rejection reveals the real number; composite_cover.py then uses it verbatim.

kdp_metadata.description:
KDP listing metadata. Description <=4000 chars (HTML

allowed); target just under. Substitute ' - ' for em-dashes in fields that reject them.

categories.description: Up to 3 KDP categories at submit; more via Author Central.

keywords.description: 7 long-tail keyword slots, <=50 chars each, no quotes/commas, each a distinct reader angle.

isbn_policy.description: kdp_free = KDP assigns a free print ISBN + overlays its own barcode; Kindle needs none (ASIN).

authorship.description: The human-in-the-loop dial. Class A=human-only/outline; B=scaffold with [BO-WRITES] markers; C=full machine draft. Authoritative from the contract; never silent-upgraded.

quality_gate.description: If true, the deterministic engine's integrate stage HARD-FAILS on authorial_act.py findings (the single-authorial-act gate: register-uniformity, verbatim cross-unit callbacks, meta-openers, summary boxes, repeated endings). Default false = advisory (the verdict is logged, never blocks). Enable once the manuscript is tuned to read as one continuous authorial act.

voice.description: Voice calibration + drift lint inputs. Feeds lint_manuscript.py and the Context Pack.

unit_noun.description: Generalizes the command grammar: 'generate chapter N' vs 'generate part N'.

blacklist.description: Forbidden phrasings/vocabulary (e.g. delve, crucial, leverage-as-verb, meta-openings). Hard exit-1 lint outside scaffolding dirs.

sacred_terms.description: Glossary of terms with locked usage ('Never Say Instead'); e.g. an exact refrain wording that must not drift.

no_em_dashes.description: HARD gate: forbid em-dashes (U+2014) and en-dashes (U+2013) in prose. Default TRUE (Bo's named #1 AI-tell). lint_manuscript.py fails (exit 1) on any em/en-dash in a manuscript file. Compound-adjective hyphens (U+002D) are never flagged. A non-Bo book that legitimately uses em-dashes sets this false. See docs/author_voice/AUTHOR_VOICE_Bo_Chen.md §1.

check_part_pages.description: Optional recto-parity heading override consumed by check_part_pages.py. If absent, headings are synthesized from units[].title / voice.unit_noun.

headings.description: Explicit ordered list of heading STEMS to Find on recto pages (matched before the dash tail).
